_doc: M1 — LODGMENT, the whole operation as ONE mission in five phases: SCOUT / CLEAR / HOLD OBJ KEATON, then BUILD FOB KEATON and OPEN THE SUPPLY LINE. The commander sees the full scheme of maneuver on the board at H-hour, the way a real OPORD lays it out; the LINES OF SUPPLY tasking still arrives as a FRAGO card when the town is held (explicit `frago` effect), because that phase is where higher hands the sustainment piece over. Trigger effects execute in declaration order (determinism law). COLD START (2026-07-25): NOTHING is fielded at H-hour — the commander calls the force up from garrison and forms the first battle group; the tutorial teaches it. Town garrison is second-line troops with Javelins stripped (AT4s only, tuned after the Phase 3 playtest). The wider theater is NOT empty: garrisons sit on the infrastructure, known to intel only as UNKNOWN contacts.
name: LODGMENT
brief: TASK FORCE, THIS IS HIGHER. You have a foothold ashore. Push inland and seize the crossroads town to your front, designated OBJECTIVE KEATON — it owns the road net. Intel has marked UNKNOWN enemy contacts in the town, but they are CONCEALED in the buildings: you will not see them until your scouts find them or they open fire. Nothing is fielded at H-hour: your battalion stages from CP GARRYOWEN — call up your scouts and your assault force from garrison and task-organize them as you see fit. Scouts screen forward; put them on BREAK before they step off. Expect a counterattack once you take the town. No fires support yet. The operation runs in five phases: FIND them, CLEAR the objective, HOLD it — then make it stick with a forward operating base and a standing supply line. Phase details follow by FRAGO. FIND THEM. CLEAR OBJ KEATON. HOLD IT.

radio.text: COUNTERATTACK INBOUND — HOSTILE ARMOR MOVING ON THE TOWN
1ACB RELEASES A SHADOW ORBIT — ASSET AVAILABLE FOR TASKING

do.title: LINES OF SUPPLY
do.text: GOOD WORK ON THE CROSSROADS. Make it stick. Engineers and a logistics platoon are pushing up to you from the rear — bring them forward and establish FOB KEATON in the town, then run a supply line up to it. Field whatever the task force can give you if you need it. ESTABLISH FOB KEATON. OPEN THE SUPPLY LINE.

radio.text: FOB KEATON IS OPEN FOR BUSINESS
2ABCT RELEASES A C-RAM SECTION TO THE DIVISION POOL

hints.text: YOUR BATTALION IS IN GARRISON — nothing is fielded yet. Your force lives in the FORCES rail on the left edge; CALL UP opens the garrison.
hints.action: CLICK ＋ CALL UP in the FORCES rail (open the rail from the left edge if it's tucked away).

hints.text: SCOUTS LEAD — the town's garrison is CONCEALED: nobody SEES them until they are found, or they fire. Your recon platoon sees farthest — it goes first, before anything else rolls.
hints.action: CLICK the ⊕ on the SCT PLT row (filter by type with the icon tabs).

hints.text: SET THE SCOUT SOP — scouts screen, they don't slug. The BREAK drill makes them disengage and fall back on their own if the hidden garrison springs on them.
hints.action: LEFT-CLICK your scout platoon.

hints.text: SET THE SCOUT SOP — with the scouts selected, put them on BREAK: if they take fire, they break contact automatically instead of standing and fighting.
hints.action: CLICK BREAK in the bottom tray.

hints.text: SCREEN FORWARD — push your scouts toward the town. From the highlighted point they can spot the hidden garrison at standoff; if it opens fire on them, they will break away on their own.
hints.action: SELECT the scouts, then RIGHT-CLICK the highlighted point.

hints.text: BUILD YOUR ASSAULT FORCE — while the scouts screen forward, call up the rest of your force. At least THREE more elements: the mix is your call as commander.
hints.action: CLICK ＋ CALL UP in the FORCES rail.

hints.text: BUILD YOUR ASSAULT FORCE — call up at least THREE more elements while the scouts are moving. The mix is your call: two Bradley platoons and the mortars is a solid start for clearing a town.
hints.action: CLICK ⊕ on the platoons you want (three or more).

hints.text: EYES FORWARD — your recon platoon carries a hand-launched Raven UAV. Get it up WHILE they drive: the feed shows the ground ahead of them.
hints.action: LEFT-CLICK your recon platoon.

hints.text: LAUNCH THE RAVEN — its drone goes up right over the platoon and gives you a live feed of the ground ahead.
hints.action: CLICK ⊕ RAVEN in the bottom tray.

hints.text: CONTACT — the garrison is fixed on the map. TASK-ORGANIZE: how you fight this is YOUR call. Platoons selected together move and fight as one BATTLE GROUP (it shows up in the BATTLE GROUPS rail on the left). Pick the platoons you want on the assault.
hints.action: DRAG a box (or SHIFT-CLICK) to select TWO OR MORE of your platoons.

hints.text: SET ATTACK POSTURE — attack orders send your battle group in to close with and destroy, instead of just moving.
hints.action: CLICK ATTACK in the bottom tray (or press E).

hints.text: ASSAULT — your battle group will advance on the highlighted enemy and clear the position.
hints.action: RIGHT-CLICK the highlighted enemy.

hints.text: SPREAD OUT — your platoons are stacked: one artillery shell can catch a bunched-up position.
hints.action: SELECT them, then RIGHT-CLICK and DRAG a line through the buildings.

hints.text: TAKE THE TOWN — urban cover protects your platoons, and a spread line can't be caught by a single shell.
hints.action: SELECT your platoons, then RIGHT-CLICK and DRAG a line across the town.

hints.text: DIG IN — prepared fighting positions stack with the urban cover for even more protection. Hold here and defeat the counterattack.
hints.action: With your platoons in the town selected, CLICK ⛨ DIG IN in the bottom tray.

hints.text: BRING UP THE SUSTAINMENT — your engineer and logistics platoons are pushing up from the rear. Columns move much faster on ROADS.
hints.action: SELECT them both, then RIGHT-CLICK the highlighted road point.

hints.text: QUEUE THE NEXT WAYPOINT — they will follow the road, then push up to the FOB site in the town.
hints.action: HOLD SHIFT and RIGHT-CLICK the town.

hints.text: ESTABLISH THE FOB — your engineer platoon does the building.
hints.action: LEFT-CLICK your engineer platoon.

hints.text: ESTABLISH THE FOB — with the engineers selected, installations are built from the COMMAND rail.
hints.action: CLICK Forward Op. Base in the rail on the left.

hints.text: PLACE IT — the engineers start construction; the supply truck on site is what lets you build this far forward of the HQ.
hints.action: CLICK a spot inside the town.

hints.text: OPEN THE SUPPLY LINE — your logistics platoon runs standing convoys.
hints.action: LEFT-CLICK your logistics platoon.

hints.text: OPEN THE SUPPLY LINE — a standing run keeps the FOB stocked without further orders.
hints.action: CLICK SUPPLY RUN in the bottom tray.

hints.text: SET THE ROUTE — the trucks will loop HQ → FOB on their own, delivering supply every run.
hints.action: CLICK the FOB.

seek.text: CASUALTIES — the flashing platoon is below HALF strength. A mauled platoon fights at a fraction of its power; pull it out before it is destroyed.

act.text: BREAK CONTACT — the BREAK drill makes this platoon disengage and fall back on its own whenever it comes under fire. You can set it on any unit, any time.
act.action: CLICK BREAK in the bottom tray.
